title: Delivery Delay Mileage Credit for Trade-In Agreements
content:
Where the delivery of the purchase a **Trade-In Agreements** trade is applied to slipped through Kestrel's own lateness, a delivery-delay credit is taken off the miles of mileage overage charged on that trade.

## Rule

The slip is counted in calendar days from the delivery's original scheduled date to its completed date, both read from the delivery appointment under **Delivery & Pickup Appointments** for that purchase order. Only a completed delivery whose last missed-attempt cause is Kestrel running late earns a credit.

| Completed delivery, last missed-attempt cause Kestrel running late | Credit miles per day of slip |
|---|---|
| Slip of 7 days or more | 60 |
| Slip of at least 3 days but fewer than 7 | 40 |
| Any other delivery (shorter slip, another cause, or not completed) | None |

The credit is the credit miles per day multiplied by the days of slip. It is subtracted from the miles charged, and the miles left are never fewer than none.

## Boundaries

| Slip | Credit miles per day |
|---|---|
| 2 days | None |
| 3 days | 40 |
| 6 days | 40 |
| 7 days | 60 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- Original scheduled date the 4th, completed the 9th: a slip of 5 days, last missed-attempt cause Kestrel running late. Credit 5 multiplied by 40, which is 200 miles. With 1300 miles charged, 1100 miles remain charged.
- Same slip, last missed-attempt cause the customer being unavailable: no credit.
- Slip of 8 days, cause Kestrel running late: credit 8 multiplied by 60, which is 480 miles. With 300 miles charged, the miles left are none, not a negative figure.
